engineering_qa.answer_zh: 它从 MoCap/视频扩展数据，并在 retargeting 中加入 physical regularizing loss，目标是同时保留规模和动态可行性。线程称达到 3× AMASS 规模、未见动作跟踪约提升 20%，但应回到论文核对指标。
engineering_qa.applicability: 适用于人形运动跟踪数据构建。
engineering_qa.question_zh: 大规模人类动作数据物理不可行时，PHUMA 如何处理？

selected_comments.text:
Existing humanoid datasets face a dilemma:
• Small Scale + High Physical Quality (e.g., LaFAN1, Loco-Mujoco)
• Large Scale + Low Physical Quality (e.g., Humanoid-X)

 Our Goal: To deliver the first dataset with Large Scale AND High Physical Quality for humanoid retargeting.

We achieved this breakthrough by proceeding in two key steps:

1. Collecting Diverse Human Motion Sources (from MoCap to Videos).

2. Retargeting them with an added Physical Regularizing Loss to enforce dynamic feasibility.

This process allowed us to secure a large-scale collection of physically feasible human motion sources, resulting in PHUMA.

• PHUMA maximizes the physical reliability of retargeted humanoid motions compared to other datasets.

We tested PHUMA’s effectiveness in imitating unseen motions and path following.

1. Motion Tracking Task:
• The policy trained on PHUMA achieved the highest success rate when imitating unseen motions, proving its strong generalization capability.

metadata.wbc_relevance_reason: 动作数据的物理可行性决定 tracking policy 与 WBC 是否从训练阶段就带有不可执行参考。

summary: PHUMA 试图兼顾规模与物理质量：从 MoCap 和视频收集动作，再在重定向中加入 physical regularizing loss 以约束动态可行性。线程称数据规模约为 AMASS 的 3 倍，并在未见视频动作跟踪上提升约 20%。
title: PHUMA：用物理正则缓解大规模动作数据的可执行性问题
